App.message.close.note: Tooltip and screen-reader name of the × button at the right of the message bar (under the toolbar): it dismisses the message shown.

App.screen.label.note: Screen-reader name of the machine's screen (the canvas the guest draws on, in the page's main area).

App.screen.hint.note: Hint shown over the machine's screen while typing doesn't go to the machine (the screen hasn't the focus) and the toolbar's mouse lock is off.

App.screen.hintLock.message: Click to type and capture the mouse, Esc to release it
App.screen.hintLock.note: Hint shown over the machine's screen while typing doesn't go to the machine and the toolbar's mouse lock is on: a click also hands the machine the mouse.

BootCard.serial.message: No video output. The guest may be sending boot menus and setup instructions to the serial console.
BootCard.serial.note: Line on the boot card (over the screen while a machine starts) when the guest's boot menus or first-boot questions go to the serial console instead of the screen; a Show serial console button follows.

BootCard.serial.show.note: Button after the boot card's line about the serial console: it shows the serial terminal.

MoveButtons.up.note: Screen-reader name of the Up arrow button of an item in an ordered list (a machine's disks, shared folders, network adapters on the Machines page): moves it up.

MoveButtons.down.note: Screen-reader name of the Down arrow button of an item in an ordered list (a machine's disks, shared folders, network adapters on the Machines page): moves it down.

MoveButtons.up.title.note: Tooltip of the Up arrow button of an item in an ordered list on the Machines page, where the list doesn't say what moving means there.

MoveButtons.down.title.note: Tooltip of the Down arrow button of an item in an ordered list on the Machines page, where the list doesn't say what moving means there.

ask.confirmTitle.note: The title of a confirmation dialog (OK/Cancel) that doesn't give a title of its own.

ask.title.note: The title of a notice or a text prompt that doesn't give a title of its own: the product's name.

ask.ok.note: The confirm button of the page's dialogs (questions, notices, text prompts) that don't name their own action.

ask.cancel.note: The button that dismisses one of the page's questions or text prompts without doing anything (Esc does the same).

ValueField.copy.note: A field with a value in it (an address, a key, a link, a command: the toolbar's Network menu, an adapter's details, the Network wizard): the tooltip and spoken name of the copy icon inside the field, after its text, that copies the value.

ValueField.copied.note: A field with a value in it (an address, a key, a link, a command: the toolbar's Network menu, an adapter's details, the Network wizard): the copy icon's tooltip and spoken name for a moment after it copied the value (the icon is a check then).

ValueField.show.note: A field with a value in it (an address, a key, a link, a command: the toolbar's Network menu, an adapter's details, the Network wizard), a secret shown as dots: the tooltip and spoken name of the eye icon inside the field that shows its text.

ValueField.hide.note: A field with a value in it (an address, a key, a link, a command: the toolbar's Network menu, an adapter's details, the Network wizard), a secret shown in clear: the tooltip and spoken name of the crossed-out eye icon inside the field that hides its text again.
